artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan discriminating the WORK (d) absent-handoff branch on recover_json's .reason, adding a RECOVERY_DECLINED defect class with agent-file attribution, and first restoring the already-red postflight fixture suite to green.

notes: Planning verified a pre-existing 34-failure regression in test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (return-meta-status-vocabulary.sh missing from setup_sandbox's copy list); a two-line fix was proven to restore 110 passed / 0 failed and is Phase 1. Research's corrections adopted: .reason is the discriminating field, and system-defect-record.sh's --dispatched-agent already provides the agent-name resolver.
